name: The Rise of the Machines
summary: In the Burning Steppes, the machines bore marks that now send you to Lotwil Veriatus.

sections.title: Marks on the Shards
sections.body: The shards bear G.L.A., with a rank marking beneath. The machines you brought down in the Burning Steppes bore Rank IV, which Theodora takes to be a low rank. So Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania sends you with a sample shard to Lotwil Veriatus, renowned among scholars of elemental sciences. Lotwil is stationed at a camp to the east, where Theodora hopes he can help with the search.

sections.title: What Lotwil Sees
sections.body: Lotwil Veriatus turns white when you show him the shard. He knows the markings.

faq.q: Who sends you to Lotwil Veriatus?
faq.answer: Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania sends you with a sample shard from the machines destroyed in the Burning Steppes for Lotwil to inspect.
Lotwil Veriatus is stationed at a camp to the east.

faq.q: What markings are on the elemental shards?
faq.answer: The shards bear G.L.A., with a rank marking beneath. The destroyed machines bore Rank IV.

faq.q: Why does Theodora want Lotwil to inspect the shard?
faq.answer: Lotwil is renowned among scholars of elemental sciences, and Theodora hopes he can help with the search.
